Resolves #19395

ADR-0034 §2.3 item 10's `setupEffect` clause now states two things the setup card's broker needs written down. The request may carry `newAttempt`, the operator's explicit consent to write the first-run witness again: admitted only for `verify`, only when the Brain's evaluated row names it as the exit, refused by name anywhere else. And the reply rule: an effect that ran answers the re-evaluated run whatever came of it, while a report that moved nothing answers a refusal in the orchestration's words. One clause, 15 lines in, 8 out.

Evidence: L1 (decision-record text, read back from the item on this head) → L1 required (every AC is text). No residual.

Decision Record impact: `amends ADR 0034`. Decision Record: Not needed beyond this amendment.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs ran (lint-staged at commit: whitespace, relative links, ticket archaeology).

| AC-2 | **The reply rule for an effect that ran and for a report that moved nothing** — outside-CI: the same clause, "An effect that ran answers the run whatever came of it … Only a report that moved nothing … answers `{ok: false, reason, effectId}`" |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. The clause also names "a halt behind an unsettled effect" among the reports that move nothing, which is the orchestration's third such report.
